node.title: THE RIGIDITY KERNEL: the one statement the four open faces consume
node.statement: RK (schema): at every FM-suppressed operating point of every row and every quotient-lattice scale (multiplicative + dihedral), every agreement object is paid-taxonomy-member (tangent / multiplicative pullback / dihedral pullback / extension) or belongs to a primitive remainder <= n^{B_RK} x FM(instance), worst-case per word/pair, jointly across characters. The four consumers: TR = RK at quotient rows; the F residue = RK for evaluation flats; the spread classification = RK for rank-loss configurations; the clean-rate exclusion = RK per-pair at the base row. Proved instances: deep-mca (radius <= 1/3-distance), pincer (1/2 via CA), flats dim <= 2 + fixed-d + MDS, the moment ledger (average case, all radii), #152 (t=2 local), #212 (cross-character reduction). The frontier = excursions along five axes (radius, dimension, quantifier, deficiency, jointness); the worst-case axis is shared by all faces and is where the exceptional-object classification lives. See experimental/notes/roadmaps/rigidity_kernel.md.
